name: Web Fullstack Application (React/Next.js + Node API + PostgreSQL)
description: Modern fullstack web application featuring rich editorial UI, REST/GraphQL APIs, relational database migrations, and zero-trust authentication.

invariants.frontend: React 19 / Next.js with Curated CSS Design System (Anti-AI Slop)
invariants.backend: Express 5 / Node.js with Zod Validation & Asymmetric JWKS Auth
invariants.database: PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) & Atomic Stored Procedures
invariants.security: Client-Side Field Encryption (AES-GCM-256) + Edge Security Headers
invariants.rate_limiting: Redis Distributed Store with Failover to Memory
invariants.testing: Automated Unit, Integration & DAST Negative Security Tests
